True or false: the Suez Canal has no locks.

image.alt: View along the Suez Canal in Egypt, calm turquoise water beside a paved embankment under a hazy sky.

body.question: The Suez Canal lets ships go between the Mediterranean and the Red Sea instead of sailing around Africa. How much shorter is the trip from the Arabian Sea to London?
body.reveal: Approximately 8,900 km, which brings the journey to about 10 days at 20 knots. The 193.3 km canal opened on 17 November 1869 after ten years of work, and it has no locks because it is a sea-level waterway.
